mapper.select: SELECT id,task_id,novel_id,chapter_no,billing_month,status,reserved,actual,input_tokens,output_tokens,model,provider,billing_mode,agent_framework,skill_version,skill_fingerprint,skill_files,created_at FROM model_calls ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM budget_lock WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(actual,reserved)),0) FROM model_calls WHERE status<>'REJECTED' AND billing_month=#{month}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(actual,reserved)),0) FROM model_calls WHERE status<>'REJECTED' AND novel_id=#{novelId} AND billing_month=#{month}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(actual,reserved)),0) FROM model_calls WHERE status<>'REJECTED' AND novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(actual,reserved)),0) FROM model_calls WHERE status<>'REJECTED' AND novel_id=#{novelId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_calls WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('UNCERTAIN','IN_FLIGHT')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_calls WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND status IN ('UNCERTAIN','IN_FLIGHT')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_calls WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='UNCERTAIN'

UPDATE model_calls SET status='RECONCILED',actual=#{actual} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UNCERTAIN'
UPDATE model_calls SET status='UNCERTAIN',error=#{error} WHERE id=#{callId} AND status='IN_FLIGHT'
